svg.title: P22: Policy floor
svg.desc: Analytical UML class view of the proposed pattern contract; not an observed implementation or execution trace.
svg.text: Primitive / UML CLASS VIEW / ANALYTICAL MODEL
dashed arrow: call dependency · brown: return/failure · analytical, not an observed trace

text.tspan: Multiple general, project, user, or session policies are merged.
A proposed action is authorized under composite policy.
Minimum floor rules, merge operator, and privileged override path.
Composition cannot weaken protected restrictions without explicit authority.
Rule identity and priority or set semantics are defined.
The merged result is at least as restrictive as every floor obligation.
Local customization cannot silently erase a protected deny rule.
Conflicts produce deny, escalation, or explicit configured precedence.
Intersection, ordered layers, scoped profiles, and administrative overrides.
Test widening, conflicting rules, missing policy, and privileged override.
A single configurable allowlist has no composition floor.
